_comment: Finance creator at 75K followers, $4K/mo flat for 90 days. Trigger: revenue-flat-90d. Playbook says course + email list. Email-list is the must-have for finance specifically (compliance / algo risk).

proposals.why: Email list is non-negotiable in finance — compliance + algorithm risk make platform-only a bet you eventually lose.
firstSteps: Substack or beehiiv (substack better for paid tier when you're ready)
Free tier weekly signal-roundup + 1 deep-dive per month
Promote on every video — 'full breakdown in the newsletter'

proposals.why: Per finance playbook at 50K+: course is the highest-LTV stream — your audience already trusts you on the analysis.
firstSteps: Pick the 1 question you get asked most in DMs
Build a 4-module Teachable course around it (~6 weeks of work)
Pre-sell at 30% off to your email list before public launch
Disclaimer + compliance review on every module before publishing

antiPatterns: Don't promise specific returns — that's a SEC violation; every claim must be hedged + disclaimed.
Don't run merch in finance — your audience didn't show up for hoodies; they showed up for signal.
